_note: AI-drafted Call to Worship — pending Wilson's curation.

registers.label: Spare
lines: The Lord bless you and keep you.
How majestic is your name in all the earth.
On the eighth day he was named Jesus: God saves.
How majestic is your name in all the earth.
Because we are children, God has sent the Spirit into our hearts.
Come, let us worship. Amen.

registers.label: Immersive
lines: Speak it slowly — the name given before he was born, the name that means God saves.
How majestic is your name in all the earth!
The same God who set the moon and stars has bent down to name a child.
How majestic is your name in all the earth!
And by that name we are no longer slaves but daughters and sons.
How majestic is your name in all the earth!
So we cry out the name written on our hearts: Abba, Father.
How majestic is your name in all the earth!

registers.label: Hybrid
lines: Named on the eighth day: Jesus, God saves.
How majestic is your name in all the earth!
The maker of the stars bends to name a child.
How majestic is your name in all the earth!
No longer slaves but children, we cry: Abba.
How majestic is your name in all the earth! Amen.
